sourceNotes.rawContent: Make a sophisticated statement with this premium blue striped enamel kada featuring a bold central pearl. Expertly crafted with a high-quality gold finish, its anti-tarnish and water-resistant properties ensure long-lasting brilliance. This modern, luxurious piece is designed to maintain its stunning luster through everyday wear.
